description: The lambda catalogue: for every canonical record type (job, agent, offer, verdict, settlement, order, …) the transformation into a sendable envelope and back — the envelope kind, the transition it names, who signs, the Rust (coord-core), TypeScript (t.coord.envelope) and proto faces, the vector that pins them — plus the aggregations the twig system folds and every venue adapter’s four transforms. Filters: ?entity= ?connector= ?kind= ?summary=1. Returns: { schema, counts, entities{}, rows[] { id, kind, connector_type, entity, envelope_kind, direction, transitions[], order_key[], signer, access, price, proof, lambda, rust, ts, proto, vectors[], owner, product }, aggregations[], adapters[], ops }. (GET /v1/lambda/catalog)

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads)

name: coord_lambda_catalog
